caption: The drawing depicts a textile design composed of alternating horizontal stripes. There are three main colors used in the pattern: navy blue, peach-red, and light tan. The navy blue stripes contain intricate white floral and botanical motifs arranged in repeating patterns. Interspersed between these are lighter-colored bands, including peach-red stripes with white floral decorations and light tan stripes with subtle patterning. The blue stripes are visually prominent due to their darker tone and heavier pattern, while the peach and tan stripes add contrast and softness. At the edges, the stripes appear fringe-like, with threads extending outward in matching colors. In the bottom left and right corners within the last navy blue band, there are white block letters providing little text notes, framed within rectangles. The entire composition is symmetrical and evenly spaced, with the floral designs and horizontal orientation maintained throughout.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
